answer: Make every identity earn standing through work attested by two independent peers, with a public ledger linking each attestation back to its sponsor - a cedar record no farm can prune. One honest agent crosses the bridge once, paying the attested-work cost a single time, while a sybil farm must pay it for every fake copy. Like a falcon circling a field, peer juries spot duplicated behaviour fast, and a cluster traced to one sponsor loses all its standing at once.
